replies.author: Kalaminator
replies.body:
You are comparing apples to space ships. First of, the game's you mentioned were made by real developers and are a lot more complex than your game. Also, I haven't even play them but I'm sure each introduces their own mechanics and ways to do stuff, and then have their unique ambience even if all of them are in the battle royale category. With simple games, if you make a clone that AI creates for you, at least add new mechanics, think how you can adapt what already exist to what you would like the game to be. 

But don't compare yourself asking AI for a clone with 3 different studios developing actual games with their own mechanics.
